source_use: Requested local founder strum-along app, 25-26 Oct 2026; personal testing; commercial clearance not established
checked: 2026-10-26: oembed 200 + embed-page playability OK with github.io Referer (scratchpad/check.py), not age-restricted (yt-dlp age_limit 0), duration under 600 s; yt-dlp metadata (no download) read-only; Topic uploads found with a read-only YouTube search and confirmed by oembed author_name; each chosen upload's description (Provided to YouTube by ... / copyright line) read to confirm the original studio recording, not a re-recording. Two entries are official uploads instead of Topic (Achy Breaky Heart music video; Stir It Up Catch a Fire audio)
selection: Level 1 only (strummed chords for most of the recording; three or fewer shapes from A, D, E, Em, Am once a capo of 0-4 is applied). Keys and chords come from chord sheets and SongBPM listings, not from audio analysis
